title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: No outright error is detectable. The implications are stated without proof, referring to p.22, so they cannot be checked from this page alone. They are internally consistent with p.46 (e.g. D ⇒ Λ3, and Λ3 ⇔ D in presence of Λ1 and Λ2).

The relation symbol in AtCΛ is ambiguous in the manuscript (a crossed comparison sign). Its exact meaning (compatibility / good position) must be taken from earlier pages; the transcription's '≱' is likely wrong.
The first implication 'Λ3 + CΛ* ⇒ C' has a scribbled-over character after C (possibly C* corrected to C), so its exact target is uncertain.

ideas.what: Order-theoretic presentation of tame topology via a poset of pieces with well-inside relation << and separation relation ||
ideas.modern_name: point-free / mereotopological axiomatics (contact algebras, proximity, way-below relation); motivation akin to o-minimal tame topology
ideas.usually_credited_to: Whitehead/de Laguna (regions), Efremovich (proximity), Scott (way-below, 1972), Düntsch–Vakarelov (contact algebras); van den Dries for o-minimality
ideas.where_published: Tame topology is only sketched in Esquisse d'un programme (1984, §5-6); this axiomatic 'atelier' approach is unpublished

ideas.what: Relativizing axioms to a dense subfamily Λ (AtΛ1–3, AtCΛ) and showing a structure is Λ-spécieux iff spécieux and Λ is very dense
ideas.modern_name: basis / dense-subfamily independence of a structure (like defining a topology or site via a basis or dense subsite)
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard idea (comparison lemma for dense subsites, SGA4 III)

ideas.what: Locality axiom: separation of approximations is decided near the intersection (AtΛ3/AtD)
ideas.modern_name: local character of disjointness; collar / neighbourhood-of-intersection principle

ideas.what: Distinction 'spécieux' vs 'polyédral' by whether intersections remain in M
ideas.modern_name: closure of a definable class under intersection (polyhedral / semi-algebraic stability)

missed.claim: The data (M, ≤, <<, ||) with density and locality axioms is essentially a contact / proximity-algebra (mereotopological) axiomatization of space. Grothendieck developed it independently of the region-based theory of space (RCC, Düntsch–Vakarelov contact algebras) and of the domain-theoretic way-below relation; no link between his tame-topology program and mereotopology seems to be recorded.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could give a point-free foundation for tame / o-minimal topology and connect Grothendieck's 'topologie modérée' to the existing literature on contact algebras and spatial reasoning.

missed.claim: The program of characterizing when a system (M, ≤, <<, Λ, ||) comes from a tame 'atelier' structure, with equivalent complete axiom systems, was never published or developed further.
missed.quote: On a encore les implications (comparer p. 22)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: An axiomatic, combinatorial foundation for tame topology remains an open desideratum of the Esquisse; these notes contain a concrete proposal.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a technical step (relativizing axioms to a dense subfamily, plus an implication diagram) in an unpublished axiomatization of tame topology. It is interesting as unpublished detail of the Esquisse program, but the individual statements are routine-looking, and no striking finished result appears on this page.
transcription_corrections: 'comb_Λ' should read 'omb_Λ' (ombre / shadow), consistent with p.44.
The relation in AtCΛ(spec) and AtCΛ(pol) is a crossed comparison symbol between X and Y (a positional / compatibility relation), not clearly '≱'.
Marginal note: 'densité de Λ' points to AtΛ1; the margin also reads 'Si on a AtΛ1 et AtΛ2, on dit que Λ est très dense' and 'si Λ = L : on retrouve AtL3'.
In 'Λ3 + CΛ* ⇒ C' the character after C is scribbled over (possibly a corrected 'C*').
In the definition of L in AtCΛ(spec), a struck-out phrase precedes 'défini par tilde L = tilde X ∩ tilde Y'.
